_comment: Human-labelled ground truth for the 40-photo adversarial candidate set, recorded by the product owner (DEC-041). The photographs themselves are real candidate images and are NEVER committed: they live outside the repository and this file references them by filename only. It exists so appearance-detector work has a measurable target instead of an opinion, and so a later classifier can be scored rather than eyeballed.
_source_directory: local only, not in version control
_labels_are_the_specification: Where a detector and a label disagree, the label is investigated first. One such disagreement (two photographs labelled perfect that a frame-based exposure rule called severely underexposed) exposed a real defect: exposure must be measured on the face, not the frame.
_what_clean_does_NOT_mean: The 'clean' label records pose, image quality and rule compliance. It says nothing about whether the lighting is good. These photographs must NOT be used to derive a lighting or colour target: doing so would import whatever illumination they happened to have as a specification, and an absolute luminance target would lighten dark skin. Enhancement corrects capture defects relative to each photograph's own rendering (see DEC-043).

_engine_disagreements.11: Labelled head_covering. The head carries marigold flowers and the face carries markings rather than a cap. The distinction matters because IBPS, GATE and the Indian Navy permit religious or ceremonial head coverings that SSC prohibits as caps.
_engine_disagreements.24: Labelled face_not_visible. The face is not dark -- it is the most colour-cast in the set, reading blue minus red of +58.8 where skin under neutral light runs -38 to -88. The defect is the illuminant, not the exposure.
_engine_disagreements.10: Labelled not_frontal. Measured yaw 1.5, pitch 2.1, roll -4.4 degrees, which is inside ordinary seated variation, so the engine accepts it.
_engine_disagreements.28: Labelled not_frontal. Measured yaw 5.7, pitch -0.3, roll 4.1 degrees; same reasoning as photo 10.
_engine_disagreements.20: Labelled sunglasses. The engine flags it, but for head pose rather than eyewear: sunglasses detection is not reliable with the shipped models.
